din444.source: DIN 444 eye bolt / Augenschraube, Type B (M12x70). Envelope confirmed vs fasteners.eu DIN 444 table (M12: eye bore d2=12 H9, eye outer dia d3=25 max, transition radius r approx 6, eye width s=14 max for Types B/C, stock lengths 30-300) + boltingspecialist.com DIN 444 Type B table (M12x1.75: d2=12 H9, d3=25 H14, r=6, s=14 H12, thread length b=30, stock lengths 70 and 100). eye_od=25.0 is d3, eye_hole=12.0 is d2, eye_t=14.0 is s. d_shank=12.0 is the M12 major diameter (envelope-only, no drawn thread). length=70.0 is a tabulated stock length (boltingspecialist M12x70), read as the shank length below the eye. tip_chamfer=1.2 REPRESENTATIVE 45-degree lead. The eye-to-shank transition radius r=6 is omitted; the straight neck at shank width is representative form.

din444d.source: DIN 444 M12, app image-variant key -- identical eye-bolt envelope, aliases the din444 base.
